newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products track crude higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products track crude higher.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer across the barrel on Thursday.
Naphtha was firmer but buying was mainly limited to specific quality or delivery point/timing leaving bids bids for similar product varying widely and trade thin.
Eurograde gasoline barges traded up to around $212 fob Rotterdam but regular lagged around $11 under this level.
Gas oil rebounded as benchmark IPE futures retraced gains to close up $3.50, short-covering demand into France firmed diesel.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil barges were firmer and traded between $115 and $118 fob ARA -London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7456
